title: Detector causing false alarms
summary: A detector triggers alarms with no apparent intrusion.
symptoms: Alarms at similar times of day

outline.title: Review the event history
outline.detail: Look for a pattern in time, weather or building activity.

outline.title: Inspect the detection area
outline.detail: Look for heat sources, moving objects, pets, drafts or direct sunlight.

outline.title: Check mounting and settings
outline.detail: Compare mounting height, orientation and sensitivity with the manufacturer's guidance.

outline.title: Check wiring and supply voltage
outline.detail: Low or noisy supply voltage and poor terminations can cause false triggers.

verification.notes: Demonstration workflow outline. General fault-finding order only — follow the manufacturer's documentation and site procedures.
